_comment: Textures removed so modern Minecraft renders its own (correct) version. Cases, all verified against vanilla old-vs-new: (1) The horse was reworked in 1.11 - the 1.8.9 texture fills only ~28% of the UV the modern model reads -> mostly invisible horse, and (unlike the chest) the re-unwrap has no clean remap. (2) The creative-inventory tabs, whose art in the proving-ground pack is unfinished dev placeholders (red 'UN SEL' / blue 'SEL' boxes, ~94% transparent panels) - vanilla is the better outcome. (3) villager.png, the one GUI whose modern REFERENCE CANVAS differs from 1.8.9's: 1.8.9 is 240x166 content on a 256x256 canvas, modern is 276x166 on a 512x256 canvas. The filename is identical in both eras and no slice record reads it (they read villager2.png), so it passes straight through and modern samples it at scale (1.0, 2.0) -> vertically squashed, slots misplaced, GUI overflowing. 1.14's trading redesign also added a trade-list panel on the left that has NO 1.8.9 counterpart, so there is nothing to remap it from. See docs/known-issues.md #5. (4) enchanting_table.png, because the PACK's own art for it predates 1.8: it has one item slot where 1.8.9 has two (lapis was added to enchanting in 1.8), the slot sits in a different place, and its three enchantment bars lack the dark level-number caps. It never matched the 1.8.9 layout it ships as, so it renders wrong on any modern version - a source-pack limitation, like the creative tabs. NOT the reason recorded before 2026-07-31; see docs/known-issues.md #4. Dropping yields correct, aligned vanilla versions. Remove an entry to keep the custom texture (at the cost of the mis-map). DELIBERATELY NOT HERE: anvil.png, which was dropped until 2026-07-31 on the theory that its slot layout had drifted. Re-measurement disproved that - the 176x166 panel is 99.9% identical between 1.8.9 and modern, the pack's own anvil is a pixel-exact structural match to both, and the slicer's read boxes land exactly on 1.8.9's art - so dropping it discarded custom art for nothing. Do not re-add it; see docs/known-issues.md #4. (Chests are NOT dropped either - the chest stage remaps them, preserving custom art.) Paths relative to assets/minecraft/. lily_pad.png: a 1.8.9 waterlily.png is byte-equivalent to modern vanilla's greyscale lily pad (Minecraft supplies the colour by tint), so overriding it gains nothing and the block is invisible in-game on M8SON. Dropped to vanilla together with the lilypad= tint override the optifine stage strips.
